run_alpharank_kuhn_poker: run AlphaRank on kuhn poker game to compute equilibrium strategies and rankings
build_payoff_tables_kuhn_poker: build meta-game payoff tables for kuhn poker with configurable number of players
check_payoffs_hpt_format: check that payoff tables are in hierarchical profile (HPT) format
get_strat_profile_labels: get strategy profile labels from payoff tables for readable output
compute_alpharank: compute AlphaRank equilibrium distribution over strategy profiles given payoff tables
print_alpharank_results: print AlphaRank results including rankings and equilibrium probabilities
draw_alpharank_network: draw a network visualization of top strategy profiles from AlphaRank output
